meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 当你说要把 Python 应用(Flask/Django/FastAPI)部署到 Azure App Service 时,Claude 会自动准备资源组、托管计划和 Web 应用(没有就新建),检测框架类型,上传代码,最后给你一个 https 开头的访问网址。
howto.when: 当你提到『Flask App Service』、『Django App Service』、『FastAPI App Service』等,或要求把 Python 代码部署到 App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把我的 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: Claude 会新建资源并上传代码

say.text: 把 Django 项目部署到 App Service,应用名 myapp
say.note: 指定名称,其余配置自动推断

say.text: 用 Azure CLI 方式部署 FastAPI 到 App Service
say.note: 走 az CLI 部署路径

howto.what_en: When asked to deploy a Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) app to Azure App Service Linux, Claude creates or reuses resource group, plan, and web app, detects framework, sets startup command, enables build, uploads code, and prints the resulting https URL. No post-deploy check is run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', etc., or ask to deploy Python to App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Claude creates resources and uploads code.

say_en.text: Deploy my Django project to App Service, app name myapp
Deploy FastAPI to App Service using Azure CLI
